# Frozen Console copied-asset provenance

This catalogue is generated data for ZITADEL
[`8afa5dd37a8e723efb9eace8d09fd5c1cccef694`](https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/tree/8afa5dd37a8e723efb9eace8d09fd5c1cccef694),
not a general grant for every asset in that repository. Do not hand-edit it.
The collector pins its complete SHA-256 and independently checks actual inputs,
outputs and compiler membership on every explicit native build.

The original source/output set comes from the retained native source manifest,
generated-file manifest and compiler observation used by #377. All selected
bytes were independently joined to the following frozen originals:

- [Icons8 Line Awesome `37d58b353175bd5466820c4c1873b4764dd92719`](https://github.com/icons8/line-awesome/tree/37d58b353175bd5466820c4c1873b4764dd92719): 1,559 matching original Git blobs, plus two differing CSS files. Preserve the complete `Line-Awesome-LICENSE.md`, selecting its MIT option. The two `original-*.css` files retain the original blobs; the catalogue identifies the differing ZITADEL blobs. SVG origins are under `svg/`; CSS/fonts are under `dist/line-awesome/`.
- [Material Icons `6.7.0`](https://registry.npmjs.org/material-design-icons-iconfont/-/material-design-icons-iconfont-6.7.0.tgz): four selected formats. `Material-Icons-LICENSE` is the original complete Apache-2.0 text.
- [flag-icons `7.5.0`](https://registry.npmjs.org/flag-icons/-/flag-icons-7.5.0.tgz): 271 selected `flags/4x3/` SVGs. `Flag-Icons-LICENSE` retains the original MIT terms and Panayiotis Lipiridis copyright.
- The frozen Console's 22 `console/src/assets/i18n/*.json` translations: 3,281,240 original bytes, paired with 44 generated copies and 22 compiler embeds. Retain the exact `ZITADEL-LICENSE`, `ZITADEL-LICENSING.md` and `ZITADEL-CONTRIBUTING.md`, and require equality with this build's prepared originals. The source declares AGPL-3.0-only by default and describes exceptions and contribution terms; those declarations are not independent certification of every contributor's rights. Complete translation bodies remain in source rather than notice text.

The two original npm archives were checked against the frozen pnpm lock's full
SHA-512 integrity. Their compressed SHA-256, original package metadata SHA-256,
selected member identities and paired generated paths are retained in the
catalogue. Original archive capture/replay is owned by the complete selected-pnpm
source adapter; the companion checks the actual connected package files and
does not claim to observe an archive it did not read.

The four TTFs contribute 12 available selected Windows/en-US name records in the
frozen-byte diagnostic replay. The collector preserves their original strings
and byte spans without inventing missing icon-font declarations. Complete family
license texts remain necessary.

For regeneration, use the frozen source-tree identities, SHA-512-verified original
package archives and an authenticated actual native generated/compiler manifest.
Recheck the complete 1,858/3,716/1,858 source/output/embed joins, both original CSS
blobs, every complete license/context and the catalogue digest before changing its pin.
For translations, derive the sorted literal locale set from the frozen tree,
authenticate each Git blob and byte identity against the actual native source
manifest, then require both generated hashes and the exact compiler selection.
The collector rejects missing/extra/linked sources and outputs, substituted
context, malformed UTF-8 or JSON, duplicate keys and uncompiled translations.
The separate MDI extension in the collector retains 25 original native SVGs and
50 byte-identical generated copies without regenerating this catalogue. Its
closed data includes each native SHA-256/Git blob, immutable primary URL/hash,
author and complete original terms. Twenty-four use Pictogrammers MaterialDesign
SVG commit `9e04201d4557e729822fb57f62a316c3dea1d4a8`; retain the full
`Pictogrammers-LICENSE`, whose icon section selects Apache-2.0 and preserves
its respective-license caveat. The Mail SVG uses Google's Material Symbols commit
`6d7ca43bd6e6668531a00fcaca06d921b63dd716` and the complete original
`Google-Mail-LICENSE` Apache text. The runtime notice preserves authors and
native-wrapper modification identities, rather than claiming wrappers equal
primary bytes. Complete native bodies remain in the source offer. These terms
cover the selected original graphics only; no trademark endorsement is implied.

The OpenID/JWT SVGs are not in that retained set. The preparer replaces only their
decorative uses with existing admitted glyphs and removes the two originals and
registrations. Both generated trees and every compiler record reject them,
including escaped references outside the selected Console package. This does
not disable OIDC/JWT, change the LDAP control, or add a new font or own-code grant.
The MDI extension was prepared on 2026-10-29. Remaining official-branding,
technology/utility families and whole-distribution admission stay under #384/#308.
